title: introduce-lithium-wasm-rag-playbook-quickstart
author: Aisha Kaplan
release_notes: Add 'Lithium' RAG quickstart demonstrating a minimal WASM adapter for edge/embedded deployments, updated docs recipe, and a small e2e smoke test (Node+WASI). Backwards-compatible example; no API changes.
description: Motivation: Provide a minimal, opinionated RAG playbook that demonstrates running a retrieval-augmented agent on constrained environments (browser with WASM runtime or small Linux edge) and a docs recipe for shipping the pattern. This quickstart (codename 'Lithium') focuses on small indexes, efficient prefix caching, and a tiny WASM adapter shim to run a lightweight runtime without requiring GPU. What this PR does: 1) adds an opinionated quickstart under quickstarts/lithium-rag that includes a TypeScript WASM adapter, a Python reference shim for server-side usage, and a tiny pretrained-index packaging tool; 2) updates the docs site nav and a recipe page with step-by-step guidance for the WASM path; 3) adds a smoke e2e CI job that runs Node+WASI to validate the adapter in CI; 4) instruments the example with tracing spans and a sample observability dashboard JSON to show retrieval vs. model latency breakdown. Checklist: - [x] example code (TS WASM adapter + Python shim) - [x] quickstart README with step-by-step local dev + deployment to static host - [x] docs recipe and sidebar entry - [x] CI smoke test (Node+WASI) - [x] small telemetry dashboard JSON and probe instructions - [x] example infra manifest (docker-compose + dev script) Commits summary: - feat(lithium): scaffold quickstart and example index packaging - feat(wasm-adapter): add minimal TS->WASI adapter and example glue - docs: add lithium recipe page and update docs sidebar for quickstarts - ci: add linux-wasi e2e smoke job and test harness - perf: add small retrieval cache example and traces Changed areas (high level): - quickstarts/lithium-rag/README.md - quickstarts/lithium-rag/examples/wasm-adapter/src/index.ts - quickstarts/lithium-rag/examples/python-shim/README.md - docs/recipes/rag-wasm.md - docs/_sidebar.yaml - ci/workflows/e2e-wasi.yml - examples/dev-packager/index.js - examples/observability/lithium-dashboard.json - scripts/pack-index.sh - quickstarts/lithium-rag/manifest/docker-compose.yaml - quickstarts/lithium-rag/tests/smoke-wasi.test.ts Review thread summary: - Kai: requested tighter instructions for packaging the index and a small script for stripping embeddings to fit WASM memory budgets; follow-up commit added scripts/pack-index.sh and updated README with memory guidance. - Priya: asked for clearer telemetry instruction on adding spans to the retrieval path; author added observability/lithium-dashboard.json and inline comments in the TS adapter with tracer hooks. - Tomás: noted the adapater's TypeScript build step was missing a polyfill for globalThis in older Node; fixed in a follow-up commit and CI updated to run Node 16/18 matrices. - Security review: brief audit of the adapter surface; no secrets in repo, recommended doc note about not bundling KMS keys into static assets; added note to README. CI details: - e2e-wasi job runs the built WASM bundle inside Node's --experimental-wasi-unstable-preview1 runtime; smoke tests run a small retrieval (10 docs) then a model call using Redwood API mock; job passes in CI. - Lint and unit tests: pass on Node and Python matrix. Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-20 after approvals from Kai and Priya and green CI. Follow-ups: - ENG-7782: roadmap item to add a 'tiny runner' template for other quickstarts (out of scope for this PR). - Add a short video walkthrough to the docs (PM-451) - Consider adding a dedicated canary for WASM path in perf-canary repo. Notes for maintainers: - The WASM adapter is intentionally minimal and not production hardened; recommend vendors use it as a reference implementation. - The Python shim shows server-side packaging and a light dev-time local runner to simplify testing. - Dashboard JSON is a starting point; import into Console to visualize retrieval vs. model latency.
